services.name: Sunset Catamaran Cruise
services.desc: Best way to end your glorious day in paradise Adult (ages 13+) - $109 Child (ages 6-12) - $89 Duration and Times 70 to 90 minutes water time Check in Time: 4:15 pm Check in Place: Nawiliwili Small Boat Harbor: Slip #100 (closest to the U.S.Coast Guard station. Free parking) About This tour is a perfect way to end your glorious Day in paradise! Join legendary Kauai Beach Boys aboard their new 50 foot catamaran and drift away into the fading Hawaiian sun while sipping on tropical cocktails and enjoying spectacular Kalapaki Sunset on a pleasant evening tour. On this tour you will: Join us The most popular sunset cruise! · Starting at $89 · Ages 6+

services.name: Waterfall Swim and Hike
services.desc: Epic Waterfall Swim and Hike Adults (Ages 13+) $89 Children (Ages 6-12) $69 Times 11AM, 1 PM Monday, Wednesday, Saturday 90 minutes - 2 Hours 1.5-2 hour guided tour takes place on our private property that overlooks the Hule’ia watershed and Ha’upu Mountain range and has two secret waterfalls. A quick quarter mile (one way) hike is a great opportunity to visit two secluded waterfalls in the Lihue area. The 30’ Bamboo Falls is a great spot for pictures, and the 60’ Papakolea Falls offers the exciting opportunity to swim in, and climb behind a cascading waterfall! Requirements Starting at $89 · 2 Hours · Ages 8+

services.name: Surf Lessons
services.desc: Beginner-friendly surf lessons at Kalapaki Beach with experienced instructors and small classes. 1.5 Hours · Ages 10+

services.name: SUP Lessons
services.desc: Guided stand up paddleboard (SUP) lessons in Kalapaki’s sheltered bay, suitable for beginners and offering the island’s premier SUP surf break. 1.5 Hours · Ages 10+

services.name: Outrigger Canoe Ride
services.desc: Guided 45-minute outrigger canoe surfing and paddle experience in Kalapaki Bay led by an expert waterman. 45 Minutes • Ages 6+

services.name: Waterfall Rappel
services.desc: It’s not zip lining, it’s not rock climbing, it’s RAPPELLING Times 8:15 AM on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Please check our calendar for additional availabilities. 4 Hours About This guided rappel tour takes place on our private property that overlooks the Hule’ia watershed and Ha’upu Mountain range and has two SECRET waterfalls. After a detailed rappel safety lesson, and a practice run on the drywall, guests hike to two secluded waterfalls. Customers will first rappel the cascading 30' Bamboo Falls, followed by the towering 60’ Papakolea Falls. Guaranteed to be the most unique experience of 4 Hours · Ages 10+ Rappel Spectator · Ages 12+ Rappel

services.desc: Full-day beach rental with two lounge chairs and one umbrella from 10:00 AM to 5:45 PM. One Day Rental

blurb: We are a family of water enthusiasts eager to share our passion for the ocean. We all have a deep respect for water, an unadulterated love for surfing and paddling, and pride in our chosen profession. With stand-up paddling, surfing, canoe paddling, sailing, kayaking, snorkeling, body boarding, and just plain beach bumming… if it’s at the beach, we’ve got you covered.
